# Download Owner's Vision

[Download owners-vision.zip](https://github.com/ammarbalkhi/owners-vision/releases/latest/download/owners-vision.zip)

Extract the `owners-vision/` folder into your agent's project-local skill directory, then ask the agent to use it. The agent checks project readiness and helps you establish the approved vision. See [agent setup](../docs/agent-usage.md).

The [release page](https://github.com/ammarbalkhi/owners-vision/releases/latest) includes the ZIP's SHA-256 checksum.

For future releases, keep the asset filename `owners-vision.zip` so the download link continues to work. Publish the ZIP with its matching source version and SHA-256 checksum.
